dedupe_keys.name: osm buildings open web viewer for 3d buildings

description: OSM Buildings is a free and open-source web viewer and JavaScript library for visualising 3D building geometry, supporting most of the OpenStreetMap building tagging schema. Developers include the library from a CDN (version 4.1.1 in the documentation), create a map at a given position and zoom, add base map tiles and add GeoJSON building tiles from the OSM Buildings data service, with an API reference and a Leaflet layer variant; the public site shows buildings on a map. The README also mentions server-side documentation for OSM Buildings. Coverage: worldwide wherever OpenStreetMap has buildings, with heights and roof shapes only where they are tagged. Access: free library and tiles; attribution to OpenStreetMap and OSM Buildings is required in the example. Licence: MIT according to the package metadata; the data are OpenStreetMap data under its own licence. Caveats: the README opens with a notice that the project's name was 'seized' by another organisation, so the similarly named Cesium OSM Buildings layer is a different product; building heights are often missing in OSM. Simulation uses: quick 3D context of building stock for exposure maps and planning viewers. Related records: OpenStreetMap, CesiumJS and Cesium ion, and Overture Maps buildings.
